rule: smallest n with NB mean accuracy >= Decider's and, for a majority of the seeds, exact McNemar not significant at alpha or NB significantly better (PLAN section 6); the full imbalanced pool is excluded from the search
gap_definition: Decider accuracy minus NB mean accuracy over seeds; the CI is a paired percentile bootstrap over test items (10,000 resamples) of the per-item difference

full_pool.note: The pool is imbalanced (37% Medical) while the test split is balanced (1/7 per class): a prior shift. NB learns the pool's class priors, so it over-predicts the majority class on the balanced test set and loses recall on the small classes.
